MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Murdoch Hospital

As a Senior Cardiac Technician, you will provide technical support and associated services to the Angiography Suite - CVIL Suite, for the performance of diagnostic and interventional electrophysiology studies.

Our Angiography Department currently have Casual positions available for Senior Cardiac Technicians however all applications will be considered for future roles as they become available over the next three months.

The Position

Program and operate physiological monitoring equipment and is responsible for the interpretation and recording of physiological cardiovascular measurements in accordance with the requirements of each consultant.

Program and operate computerised electrophysiology equipment and stimulator in a cost-efficient manner and records and retrieves data from the system.

Assist in the preparation of the patient, defibrillates and participates in patient resuscitation.

Calibrate and coordinate maintenance of electrophysiology equipment.

Maintain adequate stock levels of consumables used in electrophysiology studies.

Evaluate and recommend new techniques and procedures in collaboration with senior suite caregivers and clinicians.

Keep and maintain relevant patient records in relation to procedural data as applicable

Undertake formal and informal education of all caregivers in relation to Electrophysiology studies.

You will have significant experience within the Angiography Suite setting as a Cardiac Technician including extensive experience in:

ECG recording and interpretation

Haemodynamic monitoring

Electrophysiology studies and AF-SVT catheter ablations

Holding highly developed interpersonal, negotiation and conflict resolution skills, in addition to advanced written and verbal communication, you will effectively work within the multidisciplinary team.

To succeed you will hold CEPIA post graduate qualification and Cardiopulmonary Technology, NASPE or similar with sound working knowledge of computer information technology and Work Health & Safety Legislation. Previous experience in EP cases (electrophysiology cases) such as AF-SVT ablations and EP studies in Cath Lab will be highly regarded.

Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer

Salary: $82.55 to $88.02 per hour (inclusive of casual loading), plus 12% superannuation 

Casual positions

As a casual employee, you can salary package a percentage of your earnings each pay period on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses 

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Innovative Professional Development opportunities

All applicants are asked to submit a covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements.

For enquiries, please contact Katherine Hudson, Nurse Unit Manager, on (08) 9438 9000

Applications will be reviewed throughout the advertising period. Apply today!

St John of God Health Care embraces diversity and strongly encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people with disabilities. We are committed to providing a safe environment for all children and vulnerable people in our care and proactively take measures to protect children-vulnerable people from abuse. Position: Chef
Type: Full-time
Employer: Aprbs Kardinya Pty Ltd
Location: Kardinya WA 6163
Salary: $79,500 p.a.
About the Business
Aprbs Kardinya Pty Ltd operates Ria, an authentic Indonesian street food restaurant in Kardinya as part of the established Ria98 chain founded in 1998. Specialising in signature dishes such as Ayam Penyet and a wide range of traditional Indonesian street food favourites prepared with fresh ingredients and our distinctive sambals, the restaurant delivers genuine flavours in a welcoming, casual setting through both dine-in and takeaway services. Ria Kardinya is known for its commitment to handed-down recipes, uncompromising quality, and the comforting, home-style taste that customers associate with authentic Indonesian cuisine. Our workplace culture centres on teamwork, respect for culinary heritage, passion for flavour, and a shared dedication to outstanding hospitality and memorable dining experiences for the local community.
About the Position
The Chef plays a pivotal leadership role in our kitchen, responsible for the consistent preparation of high-quality, authentic Indonesian dishes that uphold Ria Kardinya’s reputation. This hands-on position involves overseeing daily kitchen operations, maintaining strict standards of taste, presentation and food safety, contributing to menu development while preserving authenticity, and leading the kitchen team to deliver efficient, profitable service. The role is essential to our restaurant’s success, directly influencing customer satisfaction, operational excellence and the continued growth of our Kardinya location.
Key Responsibilities
Preparing and cooking authentic Indonesian dishes to a high standard, ensuring consistency in taste and presentation.
Planning, designing, and updating menus in line with customer preferences and seasonal availability while maintaining authenticity.
Estimating food and labour costs, managing portion control, and minimising wastage to maintain profitability.
Monitoring food quality, flavour consistency, and presentation standards across all dishes.
Managing stock levels, ordering specialised Indonesian ingredients, and maintaining supplier relationships.
Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene, and Work Health and Safety (WHS) regulations.
Supervising, training, and coordinating kitchen staff, including assisting with rostering and performance oversight.
Overseeing kitchen operations during service periods to ensure efficiency and timely delivery of meals.
Collaborating with management to improve menu offerings and overall kitchen performance.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Minimum AQF Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery or higher (or equivalent). Three years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
At least one year of relevant experience in a commercial kitchen environment.
Required technical skills include proficiency in authentic Indonesian cooking techniques and ingredients, menu planning and development, food costing and portion control, stock and inventory management, and strict adherence to food safety and WHS standards. Strong interpersonal skills are also essential, including effective leadership and supervision of kitchen staff, the ability to train and coordinate team members, clear communication, and collaborative problem-solving with management.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
